snp5.6:1.1:
I ask you, Blessed One.
Please tell me.
snp5.6:1.3: I hope for your words, Great Seer.
snp5.6:1.5:
I’ll train for my own
unbinding.
snp5.6:2.1:
The Buddha:
In that case,
be ardent—
snp5.6:3.1:
Dhotaka:
I see in the world of beings
divine & human,
snp5.6:3.2:
a brahman who lives
possessing nothing.
snp5.6:3.3:
I pay homage to him,
the All-around Eye.
snp5.6:3.4: From my perplexities, Sakyan, release me!
snp5.6:4.2:
The Buddha:
No one in the world, Dhotaka,
can I release from perplexity.
snp5.6:4.3: But knowing the most excellent Dhamma,
snp5.6:4.4: you will cross over this flood.
snp5.6:5.2:
the Dhamma of seclusion
so that I may know—
snp5.6:5.3:
so that I, unafflicted as space,
may go about right here,
independent,
snp5.6:6.1:
The Buddha:
I will expound to you peace
snp5.6:6.5:
you’ll go beyond
entanglement in the world.
snp5.6:7.1:
Dhotaka:
And I relish, Great Seer,
snp5.6:7.4:
I’ll go beyond
entanglement in the world.
snp5.6:8.1:
The Buddha:
Whatever you’re alert to,
snp5.6:8.4:
above, below,
across, in between:
Knowing it as a bond in the world,
snp5.6:8.5:
don’t create craving
for becoming or non-.
